sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A conifer endemic to Tasmania, Diselma archeri forms a compact shrub in wet heath and subalpine forest, usually above 1,000 m. It can reach about 6 m in the wild.

sections.title: Foliage and cones
sections.text: Its branchlets carry tiny scale-like leaves. The species is dioecious, with male and female cones on separate plants; the female cones are very small, up to about 4 mm.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No reliable food use is documented in the sources consulted.
